act: HARRISON JONES — THE RETIRED HAWTHORN TWIN'S MIS-KEYED 2026 GAME (15) MOVED TO THE ESSENDON ROW: TWIN 2026 {1 GAME, 15.0} -> {0, 0.0}, ESSENDON 2026 {7, 43.86} -> {8, 40.25}
owner_word: OWNER WORD REQUIRED BEFORE FLIGHT. Finding (Phase 0.3, 2026-10-13): store row harrison-jones-haw (_retired true, last game 2020) carries a 2026 season row {games 1, avg 15.0}. No weekly report of record (ui/data/movers.js reports 15..29) and no score file (scores/R21-R24, FW1-FW4, GF) credits a 15 to any Harrison Jones: the row was already in the 2026-07-02 seed (git -S, commit f4a4d34f) — a pre-repo R1-R14 baseline name-join artefact, before every in-repo writer (tools/ingest, round_catchup) resolved names to ACTIVE rows only. The Essendon row harrison-jones grew from the seed's {2 games, 30.5} by exactly the five weekly reports (R16 47, R18 55, R21 67, R23 22, R24 55 = 246) to {7, 43.86} (sum 307.0): the 15 is NOT among them, and a single name-join writes each listed appearance ONCE, so the twin's game is one the Essendon row is MISSING, not a duplicate. The edit moves it: (307 + 15) / 8 = 40.25 at ScoreIngestor._mean, 2 decimals; career games follow the season-row sum (owner ruling 2026-09-24). The owner may instead rule it a duplicate, in which case only the three harrison-jones-haw edits apply.
authority: owner ruling 2026-09-24 (career games = sum of season rows) + owner word on this act
